title: 第218章 无法打败我就想用肮脏手段削弱我第217章 地狱的深处
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
李凯南伸手触碰着面前的这道魔法屏障，感受着其中传来的阻力，不由微微挑眉。
来自于那道沉睡魔法的守护力量，不仅抵挡了地狱力量对爱洛公主的侵蚀，如今也挡住了李凯南带着她离开。
李凯南下意识摸向了腰间的威权王道之剑，想着直接破开眼前的屏障。
虽然不是邪恶力量，【破邪之力】没有特攻效果。
但李凯南身上的命运之力，亦有着克制一切超凡体系的强大力量！
而注意到李凯南的举动，一旁的卡拉波斯忽然开口提醒道：
“你要是强行打破了她身上的魔法守护力量，只会让她遭到反噬！”
听闻此言，李凯南手上一顿。
他不懂魔法，但卡拉波斯却是大陆最强大的女巫之一！
她既然说会遭到反噬，那李凯南多少便有些顾忌，只能看向了卡拉波斯道：
“那你有什么办法？”
卡拉波斯嘴角上扬，手指点了点自己的嘴唇，朝李凯南抛了一个“你懂的”的媚眼。
李凯南微微挑眉，当即上前就准备亲一下卡拉波斯，动作熟练得能让贝儿、莱拉克、布兰妮、拉丽莎、奥罗拉她们心疼……
但卡拉波斯却抬手阻止了想要弯腰凑过来的李凯南，反而娇笑着抓住他的手放在自己修长白皙的脖颈间，然后面色红润娇艳地凑到李凯南耳边说了什么。
李凯南猛地抬头，有些没绷住，看着卡拉波斯欲言又止、止又欲言。
好、好……好bt的要求啊！
卡拉波斯却是忍不住娇笑起来，悠悠道：
“李凯南，你也不想救不回去爱洛公主吧？”
李凯南轻叹了一口气，按照卡拉波斯的嘱托，手上开始微微用力。
卡拉波斯身体开始兴奋得颤抖起来，眼神炙热。

对，没错，我要的就是这个！
然后下一刻，卡拉波斯双手猛地揽住了李凯南的脖子，然后脸颊鼓成了*豌*豆*脸猛吸……
一旁的奥罗拉已经不是第一次经历这种事情了，但看到这一次两人之间的剧烈动作，整条龙就仿佛受到了什么暴击，直接呆愣在了那边。
作为爱洛公主一部分灵魂所诞生的奥罗拉，爱洛公主的身体也算是她的身体。
但卡拉波斯窃取了自己的身体去和李凯南发生亲密动作这种ntr行为，让此刻旁观的奥罗拉除了愤怒，更多是一种说不上来的异样感觉。
愤怒悲哀、无能为力，曾经和李凯南一起的美好记忆，和眼前的残酷现实宛如黑与白一般强烈的冲突。
然后就是自责懊悔，以及一种……
兴奋感？
奥罗拉只是一条巨龙，根本无法理解这种复杂的情绪，此刻只能僵硬在那边默默看着李凯南和卡拉波斯。
李凯南身体的本能反应，让他感觉浑身炙热，无比奇怪陌生。
这让他连忙松开卡拉波斯，然后双手强行推开了卡拉波斯。。
看着面前已然不自觉开始“哦齁齁”的卡拉波斯，李凯南皱着眉没说话。
你踏马的这么用力，是不是有点过分了？
卡拉波斯缓缓回过神来，看着李凯南满是意犹未尽。
但她也注意到李凯南眉眼间的不愉，只能不舍地松开了李凯南。
李凯南皱着眉伸手擦去嘴巴上的口水，沉声道：
content_en:
Li Kainan stretched out his hand to touch the magic barrier in front of him, feeling the resistance coming from it, and couldn't help but raise his eyebrows slightly.
The protective power from that sleeping magic not only resisted the erosion of Princess Aurora by the power of hell, but now also prevented Li Kainan from taking her away.
Li Kainan subconsciously touched the sword of authority at his waist, thinking of directly breaking the barrier in front of him.
Although it is not an evil force, [Evil-Destroying Power] has no special attack effect.
But the power of destiny in Li Kainan also has the powerful power to restrain all extraordinary systems!
After noticing Li Kainan's actions, Carabosse suddenly reminded him:
"If you forcefully break the magical protective power on her body, it will only cause her to suffer backlash!"
After hearing this, Li Kainan was stunned.
He doesn't know magic, but Carabosse is one of the most powerful witches in the continent!
Since she said there would be backlash, Li Kainan was a little wary and could only look at Carabosse and said:
"Then what can you do?"
Carabosse raised the corners of his mouth, tapped his lips with his finger, and gave Li Kainan a "you know" wink.
Li Kainan raised his eyebrows slightly and immediately stepped forward to kiss Carabosse. His movements were so skillful that they could make Belle, Lilac, Britney, Larissa, Aurora and others feel distressed...
But Carabosse raised his hand to stop Li Kainan, who was about to bend over. Instead, he smiled coquettishly, grabbed his hand and put it on his slender and fair neck. Then, with a rosy complexion, he leaned into Li Kainan's ear and said something.
Li Kainan raised his head suddenly, a little nervous, and looked at Carabosse, who was about to speak, but was about to speak.
Okay, okay...what a request from bt!
Carabosse couldn't help but smile coquettishly and said leisurely:
"Li Kainan, you don't want to be unable to save Princess Aurora, right?"
Li Kainan sighed softly, and followed Carabosse's instructions and began to exert slight force on his hands.
Carabosse's body began to tremble with excitement, his eyes burning.
Yes, that’s right, this is what I want!
Then the next moment, Carabosse suddenly grabbed Li Kainan's neck with both hands, and then his cheeks bulged into a *pea* face and he sucked hard...
It was not the first time that Aurora on the side had experienced this kind of thing, but seeing the violent movements between the two this time, the whole dragon seemed to have been hit by something, and it froze there.
Aurora was born as part of Princess Aurora's soul, and Princess Aurora's body is also her body.
But Carabosse stole his own body to have an intimate act with Li Kainan, which made Aurora, who was watching at the moment, feel an indescribable strange feeling in addition to anger.
Angry, sad, and helpless, the beautiful memory of being with Li Kainan and the cruel reality in front of him are in strong conflict like black and white.
Then there is self-blame and regret, and a kind of...
Excitement?
Aurora was just a giant dragon and couldn't understand such complex emotions at all. At this moment, she could only stare blankly at Li Kainan and Carabosse.
Li Kainan's body's instinctive reaction made him feel hot and strange.
This made him quickly let go of Carabosse, and then forcefully pushed Carabosse away with both hands. .
Looking at Carabosse in front of him who was already saying "Oh, oh" unconsciously, Li Kainan frowned and said nothing.
Isn't it a bit too much for you to step on the horse so hard?
Carabosse slowly came back to his senses and looked at Li Kainan with unfulfilled interest.
But she also noticed the displeasure in Li Kainan's eyebrows, and could only reluctantly let go of Li Kainan.
Li Kainan frowned and stretched out his hand to wipe the saliva from his mouth, and said in a deep voice:
